caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a figure with dark brown skin, wearing a large headdress composed of five upright feathers. The feathers are colored in varying shades of red, brown, and muted yellow. The figure has long, straight facial features and a stern expression, with clearly defined cheekbones and deeply set eyes. Golden or yellow bands encircle the upper arms, forming cuffs, while the figure's clothing consists of a garment colored in deep red with shading to give a fabric-like appearance, adorned with a broad collar that is alternating gold and blue-gray sections. The headdress is fastened with a gold band that runs across the forehead, with two gold, segmented ornaments hanging down on each side of the face, resembling earrings or ear pendants. The background is plain and unadorned, providing an unobstructed view of the subject.
title: Cigar Store Indian
